verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a Templates API to create, edit, list and validate templates and to push them between servers. That makes it possible to sync templates from a repository, but it is only a glancing fit for an email-as-code workflow. The evidence never mentions React Email, MJML or any first-party authoring framework. missing for 10: first-party React Email/MJML or equivalent framework docs, a documented version-control/CI template workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
